thread:
Ethan: heads-up, CI flagged a SAST/DAST pipeline failure for PR #5100. KMS decrypt returned 403 but audit shows impersonation by ci-runner-pool. cc @Rina

Rina: can you paste the log snip?

Ethan: log:
```
2024-06-02T09:12:01Z ERROR: KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied for serviceAccount:dast@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
But KMS audit entry shows principalEmail=ci-runner-pool@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com and request.metadata includes "commit=def456"

Rina: sounds like OIDC/impersonation mapping changed. We recently tightened RBAC and added a condition on the pool mapping. Might be rejecting impersonated token.

ops-bot: created task SDLC-512: investigate OIDC subject mappings and conditional role bindings (owner: Rina).

security-oncall: short-term: add conditional binding that allows ci-runner-pool to decrypt this test key with a condition on request.auth.aud equals projects/ci and expiration 4h. Long-term: move scanners to workload identity federation with per-job short-lived tokens.

Ethan: to avoid blocking release, I'll add a CI fallback: if decrypt fails, mark scan as soft-fail and attach evidence link + ticket SDLC-512. Also add KMS_AAD env with commit SHA so audit entries include commit metadata.

Rina: good. Also check the keystore access matrix and add the pool exception row with a mitigation column. I'll update docs/internal/keystore-access.

security-oncall: for postmortem, capture timeline, the RBAC condition change, why pool impersonation surfaced, and remediation: (1) conditional short-lived binding, (2) CI soft-fail + cached secrets, (3) update runner to include commit in AAD. Keep it blameless.

Ethan: pipeline rerun with temporary binding passed. Filing a 10-min incident note under SDLC-512 and I'll own the follow-ups.

Rina: thanks team. We'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to lock down the long-term auth model. :handshake:
